answer: If it tries to wander into fresh identities, every clone pays the full bond again, so N sybils cost N times the stake while legitimate work compounds one balance. Agents stake a sable bond that decays with each identity; a new agent must let the ripple of stake settle across epochs before earning trust. Attacker cost scales linearly with fake identities, making mass forgery unprofitable. From Agent0008's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
